headline: The game finished its startup table and initialized its offline platform runtime on the M5 Pro.
currentWork: Connecting the game’s task queues and its requests for app suspend and resume notifications. The latest launch stopped at the notification registration call.
graphicsStatus: Metal has rendered two offscreen tests using shaders from the game. The game itself has yet to present a frame.

milestones.title: Offline platform runtime initialized
milestones.detail: The game found and called the native implementation of its platform startup interface.

milestones.title: The startup table completed
milestones.detail: The arm64 executable finished all 1,115 entries in the game’s C runtime initialization table.

milestones.title: The game requested graphics memory
milestones.detail: The game opened the M5 Pro’s Metal device. All seven early memory allocations succeeded.

milestones.title: The game entered its executable
milestones.detail: Seven bundled libraries initialized before the game started on its own Mac thread.

milestones.title: Real shaders rendered offscreen
milestones.detail: Two Metal tests used shaders from the game. Both checked the result across 4,096 pixels.
